description: Rust backend for Lessons under src-tauri/src/lessons/ (new module, mirrors src-tauri/src/study.rs patterns): additive ensure_schema (new tables only, no ALTER of shared tables), typed data model + tolerant-parse/strict-validate layer, closed-form explainer correctness + numeric/balance grading, mastery (EMA) + SM-2-lite spaced repetition + adaptive seeded trainers + exam/readiness/certificate, portable .lesson zip bundle import(file/folder/URL)/export with per-file SHA-256 + content fingerprint integrity, purge wiring (live + backup + recording-delete cascade), seed loader, Tauri commands, and thorough tests. This is the foundation FEAT-002 (seed content) and FEAT-003 (frontend) both depend on. Independent of FEAT-003 and FEAT-004 at the code level but must land first.
steps: Add `zip = "=2.2.0"` (pure-Rust, deflate/stored only) to src-tauri/Cargo.toml. Create src-tauri/src/lessons.rs module root with `pub mod` for schema, bundle, explain, mastery, review, trainer, generators, grade, exam, purge, seed, commands, and `#[cfg(test)] mod tests`. Implement ensure_schema with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS / crate::database::ensure_columns for lesson_sets(id,title,subtitle,level,provenance,source_recording_id,transcript_fingerprint,content_fingerprint,schema_major,dir_path,imported_at), lesson_progress, mastery_records(score,attempts,correct_attempts,first_try_correct,mastered,ease,interval_days,due_at,last_reviewed_at,updated_at), exam_attempts, certificates. Register `pub mod lessons;` in src-tauri/src/lib.rs next to `pub mod study;` (~line 93), and call crate::lessons::ensure_schema(&mut conn).await? in src-tauri/src/database.rs run_migrations APPENDED after the crate::study::ensure_schema call (~line 1079).

src-tauri/src/lessons/schema.rs: serde structs for LessonSet, Concept, Lesson, Explainer (tagged union of the 9 kinds: figure, equation_balancer, mole_ratio, limiting_reagent, dimensional_analysis, molecule_diagram, titration_curve, ideal_gas_pv, misconceptions), WorkedExample, Misconceptions, QuizItem/ExamItem (tagged union mc|numeric|balance|multistep), Checkpoint, Exam, Trainer, Diagnostic, Figure — all Swift-Codable-shaped. Port clean_text + trailing-comma-tolerant extract_json from src-tauri/src/study/parse.rs. validate_* functions enforce: text cleaning; count bounds (2..=5 explainers with HARD FLOOR >=1 figure-kind per lesson; misconceptions 2..=6; choices 2..=6; checkpoint bank presentCount*2..=40; exam bank 60..=300); referential integrity (every conceptId/figureId/lessonId resolves); acyclic prerequisite DAG; every mc answerIndex in range; every numeric item carries a tolerance; mix.mc+numeric+balance+multistep==questionCount and mix.balance==0. A failed element drops; a structurally unusable file fails the whole bundle. Provenance accepted syntactically; never render as HTML.

src-tauri/src/lessons/explain.rs: closed-form recompute+verify for equation balancer (integer linear solve over per-element atom counts + total charge; authored answerCoefficients must equal computed), mole-ratio step chain, limiting-reagent, dimensional-analysis unit-multiset cancellation, ideal-gas PV; structural-only check for molecule_diagram and monotonic+equivalence-point check for titration_curve (the §6.1 carve-outs).

src-tauri/src/lessons/grade.rs: check_numeric per §9 with a single UNITS table (dimension class + scale-factor/offset: mass g, volume L, amount mol, pressure atm, temperature K; °C->K via +273.15 offset is the only non-multiply). Compatible prefixed units convert then compare within tolerance; incompatible units wrong; unknown unit unparseable (never silently graded); absent unit compares in declared unit. tolerance.kind exact|abs|rel; sci-notation parse; sigFigs guidance-only. check_balance lowest-integer order-independent. MC via stored answerIndex; multistep per-step and gated.

src-tauri/src/lessons/mastery.rs (EMA alpha=0.4, retry credit 0.7, mastered=score>=85 && correctAttempts>=3; seed_from_diagnostic), review.rs (SM-2-lite ease 1.3..=2.8 start 2.5, interval/dueAt updates deterministic), trainer.rs (next_item: rank weakest/overdue concept, difficulty tier by score <40/40-70/>=70, seeded RNG from (conceptId,attemptIndex)), generators.rs (closed enum of numeric generators + solve_with_steps emitting dimensional-analysis steps), exam.rs (30-item selection honoring mix 12/12/0/6 without-replacement across 2 recent attempts, generator-backed numeric draws fresh values; score_attempt 80% pass with gated multistep; readiness meter deterministic; certificate resultHash = SHA-256 over (contentFingerprint,scorePct,issuedAt,lessonSetId)).

src-tauri/src/lessons/bundle.rs: zip read/write (zip crate, deflate/stored only); manifest.json (format, schemaMajor/Minor, provenance, per-file sha256+bytes, contentFingerprint); import verifies every per-file SHA-256 and that the zip file-set exactly matches manifest.files; content fingerprint = SHA-256 over canonicalized content (sorted keys, figure bytes folded by hash); reject `..`/absolute zip entry paths; validate_bundle fully in a temp dir then commit in ONE DB transaction (rollback + temp-dir cleanup on failure); import_bundle forces provenance to 'imported' for user sources; figures written as loose PNGs under <app data>/lessons/<lessonSetId>/figures/; export_bundle round-trips; URL import uses the existing HTTP client, user-initiated only, with no default URL shipped.

src-tauri/src/lessons/purge.rs: purge_for_meeting resolves dir_paths first (SELECT id,dir_path WHERE source_recording_id=? AND provenance='generated'), deletes learner rows then lesson_sets rows, removes on-disk dirs last tolerating ENOENT (dir-removal failure after DB delete is logged-and-ignored); save-time BEGIN IMMEDIATE fingerprint recheck mirroring study.rs::save_locked. Wire the LIVE path: add crate::lessons::purge_for_meeting(conn, meeting_id) in src-tauri/src/redaction.rs::redact_ai_outputs next to study::purge_for_meeting (~line 668). Add a job-kind-independent crate::lessons::purge_for_meeting(&mut *tx, meeting_id) inside redaction.rs::purge_one_backup AFTER the `for job in jobs` match and BEFORE tx.commit(). Slot the cascade beside the topics/chat purge calls in database.rs::delete_meeting (~line 1350).

src-tauri/src/lessons/seed.rs: ensure_seeded(pool) compares a lessons_seed_version in app settings, imports resources/seed/stoichiometry.lesson via the ordinary import_bundle path with provenance 'seed', idempotent by content fingerprint, honoring a removal tombstone so a deliberate remove sticks. Call ensure_seeded at startup (not a command). NOTE: the actual stoichiometry.lesson artifact is produced in FEAT-002; here write the loader + a test fixture bundle so the loader is testable now.

src-tauri/src/lessons/commands.rs: lessons_list_catalog, lessons_import_bundle, lessons_remove_set, lessons_get_set, lessons_get_lesson, lessons_save_progress, lessons_submit_checkpoint, lessons_next_trainer_item, lessons_submit_trainer_item, lessons_review_due, lessons_start_diagnostic, lessons_submit_diagnostic, lessons_dashboard, lessons_start_exam, lessons_submit_exam, lessons_export_certificate, lessons_reset_progress. Register them in src-tauri/src/lib.rs invoke_handler APPENDED after the study::commands::* block (~line 890). Do NOT wire lessons_make_from_recording (deferred).

src-tauri/src/lessons/tests.rs mirroring src-tauri/src/study/tests.rs with a mock completer (no endpoint): schema validation (valid passes; malformed/oversized/cyclic/dangling/out-of-range-answerIndex/missing-tolerance fail cleanly, never panic); bundle round-trip + per-file-hash tamper + unknown schemaMajor rejected + newer schemaMinor accepted + `..`/absolute path rejected; numeric-grading table (incl. 4000 mg vs 4 g, 250 mL vs 0.25 L, 25 °C vs 298.15 K, 4 L vs 4 g wrong, 4 foo unparseable, 4 vs 4 g correct, hostile inputs never panic); balance + explainer-correctness; mastery/review/trainer scripted sequences + seeded-generator reproducibility; exam mix/scoring/gating + readiness monotonicity + two 30-item draws differ; purge (word Strike/line Delete/time-range Delete/whole-recording Delete remove a generated set from live DB AND backups exercising Screens+RangeExtras arms; seed/imported survive; screen-only edit keeps it).

`cd src-tauri && cargo test --lib --features mas` passes (sandbox-clean: no ffmpeg/Accessibility/osascript/shell, pure-Rust zip)
ensure_schema adds only new tables and is registered in run_migrations; no shared table is ALTERed
No new AI host, no default remote URL, no bundled key, no runtime image client: `python3 scripts/check-ai-provider-policy.py` still passes

findings: IMPLEMENTED. Rust backend for Lessons under src-tauri/src/lessons/. All three verification commands pass: `cargo test --lib` (446 ok, incl. 24 lessons:: tests), `cargo test --lib --features mas` (429 ok), `python3 scripts/check-ai-provider-policy.py` (PASS). DEVIATION (zip pin): FEAT/doc NIT-10 pinned `zip = "=2.2.0"`, but the entire zip 2.2.x line (and 2.0/2.1) is YANKED on crates.io. Used `zip = { version = "=2.4.2", default-features = false, features = ["deflate"] }` — the latest non-yanked 2.x, still pure-Rust, deflate/stored only, no system libzip, so the mas sandbox stays clean. FEAT-002/003 should keep this pin unless a non-yanked 2.2.x reappears. MODULE MAP (src-tauri/src/lessons/): mod.rs is src-tauri/src/lessons.rs (SCHEMA_MAJOR=1, SCHEMA_MINOR=0, lessons_root() -> /lessons, ensure_schema). Submodules: parse (extract_json/clean_text/clean_value), schema (data model + validate_set), explain (balance_equation/verify_balance/verify_explainer, parse_formula), grade (check_numeric/check_balance/check_mc/grade_item + UNITS table + Given/MultistepGiven/ItemGrade/NumericGrade), mastery (Mastery, record_attempt, seed_from_diagnostic, ALPHA=0.4), review (ReviewState, apply_review, quality_from_result, START_EASE=2.5), generators (TEMPLATES, is_known_template, SeededRng, molar_mass, solve_with_steps, GeneratedItem), trainer (ConceptState, difficulty_tier, focus_concept, next_item, NextItem), exam (select_items, score_attempt/ScoredAttempt/AnsweredItem, readiness, readiness_label, result_hash), bundle, purge, seed, commands. SCHEMA TABLES (lessons::ensure_schema, additive CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS only, registered in database.rs::run_migrations after study::ensure_schema): lesson_sets(id,title,subtitle,level,provenance,source_recording_id,transcript_fingerprint,content_fingerprint,schema_major,dir_path,imported_at), lesson_progress(PK lesson_set_id+lesson_id), mastery_records(PK lesson_set_id+concept_id; score,attempts,correct_attempts,first_try_correct,mastered,ease,interval_days,due_at,last_reviewed_at,updated_at), exam_attempts(id PK,lesson_set_id,started_at,submitted_at,answers,score_pct,passed), certificates(id PK,...,result_hash). No shared table ALTERed. BUNDLE WRITER / IMPORT ENTRY POINTS (bundle.rs): import_from_file(pool,&Path), import_from_folder(pool,&Path), import_from_url(pool,&str), import_bundle_bytes(pool,&[u8]) all force provenance 'imported'. validate_bytes(&[u8]) -> PreparedBundle (no catalog write). commit_bundle(pool,&PreparedBundle,provenance_override,source_recording_id) is the single catalog writer (one DB tx + stage-dir rename; forces provenance). export_bundle(&Path dir) -> Vec (round-trips on-disk catalog dir, rebuilds manifest with fresh sha256). write_zip(manifest_json,&[(path,bytes)]) low-level. Manifest{format,schemaMajor,schemaMinor,lessonSetId,title,provenance,files:[ManifestFile{path,sha256,bytes,kind}],contentFingerprint,figures:[Figure]}. On-disk layout /lessons//{lessonset.json,lessons/.json,figures/.png}. SEED (seed.rs): ensure_seeded(pool) called at startup in lib.rs AFTER SettingsManager::init (the seed version + removal tombstone live in the `settings` table, which run_migrations does NOT create). SEED_VERSION=1, SEED_SET_ID="stoichiometry-seed", keys lessons_seed_version / lessons_seed_removed. ensure_seeded_from_bytes(pool,&[u8]) is testable now; mark_removed(pool) sets the tombstone (called by lessons_remove_set when provenance=seed). FEAT-002 must produce src-tauri/resources/seed/stoichiometry.lesson (resources/ dir does not exist yet) and bump SEED_VERSION if content changes; seed_resource_path() looks next to the exe at resources/seed/stoichiometry.lesson and at cwd resources/seed/stoichiometry.lesson. COMMAND SIGNATURES (lessons::commands, registered in lib.rs invoke_handler APPEND after recording_kind::set_meeting_recording_kind; all camelCase; State): lessons_list_catalog() -> Vec; lessons_import_bundle(source: ImportSource{File(String)|Folder(String)|Url(String), tagged source/value}) -> String(setId); lessons_remove_set(setId); lessons_get_set(setId) -> LessonSet; lessons_get_lesson(setId,lessonId) -> Lesson; lessons_save_progress(setId,lessonId,progress:LessonProgress); lessons_submit_checkpoint(setId,lessonId,answers:Vec) -> CheckpointResult{scorePct,passed,graded}; lessons_next_trainer_item(setId,attemptIndex:u64) -> Option; lessons_submit_trainer_item(setId,conceptId,correct:bool,firstTry:bool) -> Mastery; lessons_review_due(setId) -> Vec; lessons_start_diagnostic(setId) -> Option; lessons_submit_diagnostic(setId,answers) -> Vec; lessons_dashboard(setId) -> Dashboard{concepts,checkpointsPassed,totalLessons,examUnlocked,readinessPct,readinessLabel}; lessons_start_exam(setId) -> StartedExam{attemptId,items} (gated: all checkpoints passed); lessons_submit_exam(setId,attemptId,answers) -> ExamResult{scorePct,passed,graded} (issues certificate on pass); lessons_export_certificate(setId) -> Option; lessons_reset_progress(setId). SubmittedAnswer{itemId,choiceIndex?,numeric?,coefficients?,multistep:[SubmittedStep{choiceIndex?,numeric?,coefficients?}]?,firstTry}. lessons_make_from_recording intentionally NOT registered (deferred §13). PURGE (purge.rs, docs/LESSONS.md §11.4): purge_for_meeting(&mut SqliteConnection, meeting_id) deletes WHERE source_recording_id=? AND provenance='generated' (resolve dir_paths first, delete learner rows then lesson_sets, remove dirs last tolerating ENOENT). Wired: live redaction.rs::redact_ai_outputs beside study::purge_for_meeting; job-kind-independent in redaction.rs::purge_one_backup after the `for job in jobs` match and before tx.commit(); cascade in database.rs::delete_meeting beside topics/chat. count_for_meeting also exposed. Seed/imported never touched. In this build no generated set is produced, so tests insert a synthetic generated lesson_sets row to exercise all three hooks. FRONTEND NOTES for FEAT-003: all grading/correctness is authoritative in these Rust commands; the TS mirror (src/lib/lessonLogic.ts) must be preview-only. Explainer kinds + payloads are in schema.rs (figure data = {figureId,alt}; others carry structured params verified by explain::verify_explainer). Figures render as from /lessons//figures/.png; never render any bundle string as HTML.
